articles.title: Delhi government has decided to construct hostels for 10,000 students: CM Rekha Gupta
articles.summary: Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta announced plans for the construction of fully equipped and secure hostel facilities for 10,000 students. This initiative by the Delhi government aims to provide safe and comprehensive accommodation for students enrolled across colleges in the capital. The project emphasizes student welfare and aims to enhance access to higher education by addressing accommodation needs effectively.

articles.title: Chandrayaan-1 finds clues to a Moon basin lost in time
articles.summary: India's Chandrayaan-1 mission data has provided crucial mineralogical evidence of an ancient, hidden impact basin on the Moon. This significant basin is no longer visible through conventional topographic or gravity data, highlighting the mission's profound contribution to lunar geology. The discovery underscores India's growing prowess in space research, offering new insights into the Moon's early history and geological evolution.

articles.title: NATO fighter jet shoots down drone over Lithuania
articles.summary: An Italian NATO fighter jet successfully intercepted and shot down a drone over Lithuanian airspace early Tuesday morning, as reported by the Lithuanian National Crisis Management Centre. This event underscores NATO's robust air defence posture and commitment to territorial integrity, demonstrating the alliance's constant vigilance and rapid response capabilities in safeguarding member states amidst regional security challenges. It highlights operational readiness crucial for collective defence.

articles.title: DRDO develops GaN chip: Meet Dr Meena Mishra, scientist behind the technology that was denied by other countries and why it matters for Indian defence platforms
articles.summary: Dr. Meena Mishra, Director of DRDO's Solid State Physics Laboratory (SSPL), played a pivotal role in India's successful indigenous development of critical Gallium (Ga)-based technology. This significant achievement by DRDO enhances India's self-reliance in advanced defence materials, vital for modern electronic systems and bolstering national security. It exemplifies India's growing scientific and technological capabilities in defence.

articles.title: Cast your vote for the Oshkosh and Fond du Lac Athlete of the Week
